messages:
maria: Kicking off geo-staging wave for v3.2.0. Plan is US -> EU -> APAC, canary 5%, then 25% -> 100%. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Need capacity thumbs and any thermal/quota flags. Deploy bot will post jobs shortly.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job_id=deploy-1738209021-v3.2.0. Plan: us(5%,25%,100%) then eu then apac. ETA start 2025-11-29T02:15:00Z. Use /deploy abort <job_id> to halt.

raj: quick Q — are we pinning model variant to v3.2.0-quant for EU? We saw a perf delta last week.

maria: yes pin EU to v3.2.0-quant for this wave. US will use v3.2.0 (fp16) initially. APAC we may use the quantized fallback if thermal spike.

emma: Capacity readout: US warm pool 120 GPUs, expected slice at 5% = ~6 GPUs, buffer ok. EU warm pool 60 GPUs, 5% = 3 GPUs. APAC warm pool 28 GPUs, 5% = 2 GPUs (tight).

tom: APAC looks tight. ops-sre, any objection to temporarily reserving 4 extra for APAC burst?

ops-sre: We can reserve 4 but runs close to thermal limit on apac-01 between 03:00-04:30 UTC. If we see 90% GPU temp for >5min, autoscale will be disabled. Recommend canary hold at 5% for 20m and smoke test.

raj: Agreed on 20m hold. Also add a regression check: latency P95 must be <= 320ms in US/EU, <= 450ms APAC. If breach, rollback to pinned earlier version.

maria: Marking rollback criteria: (1) errors > 0.5% sustained 5m, (2) P95 latency breach per region, (3) model quality regression alert from eval-run-1738209. If any triggered, immediate rollback to previous stable with deploy-bot abort and manual pin.

deploy-bot: Canary step started for US at 2025-11-29T02:15:30Z — slice=5% job_id=deploy-1738209021-v3.2.0-step1. Logs: https://deploys.internal/reports/deploy-1738209021

oncall: Watching US canary. I'll post smoke queries in 10m and check logs/traces.

emma: US canary stats @ +12m: error rate 0.08%, P95 300ms, token cost stable. No regressions seen in the eval harness. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: EU ready to start warmup. Reserving EU burst +2 GPUs now. APAC reserve queued awaiting thermal cooldown.

deploy-bot: EU canary started at 2025-11-29T02:42:00Z — slice=5% job_id=deploy-1738209021-v3.2.0-eu-step1.

maria: Reminder: release notes pinned in GH release notes PR #812. Link posted in deploy channel. Anyone add risky rollout notes?

raj: Noting subtle prompt-changes in assistant persona that could surface in edge prompts — add a line in release notes for Support.

tom: APAC cooldown hit 03:11 UTC; ops-sre triggered 10m cooldown. We'll delay APAC start to 03:40 and increase hold to 30m for APAC.

ops-sre: Confirmed. APAC start scheduled 2025-11-29T03:40:00Z. If thermal persists, we'll fallback APAC to v3.1.9-quant and mark incident runbook.

deploy-bot: EU promoted to 25% at 2025-11-29T03:03:10Z. US promoted to 25% at 02:40:00Z earlier.

emma: EU stats @ +22m: errors 0.12%, P95 310ms. Within thresholds. Proceed to 100% after 20m stable.

maria: We have go to promote EU to 100% at 03:25 UTC. APAC will be standby. If APAC thermal OK at 03:40, start canary then.

deploy-bot: EU promoted to 100% at 2025-11-29T03:25:12Z. Job complete for EU.

oncall: Noted. Monitoring APAC.

ops-sre: APAC thermal back to normal at 03:35. Allowing deploy to start at scheduled 03:40 with 30m canary hold.

deploy-bot: APAC canary started 2025-11-29T03:40:02Z — slice=5% job_id=deploy-1738209021-v3.2.0-apac-step1.

emma: APAC @ +15m: P95 460ms (slightly above), errors 0.3%. ops-sre any insight?

ops-sre: APAC latency bump tied to one hot zone, we're shifting traffic away from apac-01 to apac-03 and apac-04. Request throttles applied for 10m and rebalancing ongoing.

maria: Because APAC P95 > threshold, we trigger rollback criteria. Initiating abort and rollback to v3.1.9-quant for APAC.

deploy-bot: Abort received for job_id=deploy-1738209021-v3.2.0-apac-step1. Rolling back APAC to v3.1.9-quant. Rollback job_id=rollback-1738209021-apac.

emma: APAC after rollback @ +12m: P95 420ms, errors 0.04%. APAC stabilized.

maria: Closing wave: US/EU on v3.2.0, APAC rolled back to v3.1.9-quant. Postmortem notes: increase APAC warm pool and pre-warm apac-03/04 before next wave. I'll open follow-up ticket. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
